question: Does the way the training target is built change localization, with representation and architecture held fixed?
representation: P = frozen top5 readout (profiles_full[:, :, 0] of Step 432); Z = per-answer per-channel standardization (population SD, SD<=1e-8 -> 1). Student input = Z[a,s,:], exactly 11 channels; no position, length, labels or text.

arms.BASE: teacher itself (argmax q_loc / q_step ranking); no fit
arms.P_HARD: PB one-hot at earliest-tie argmax q_loc; PRMB per-step 1[q_step >= 0.5]
arms.P_SOFT: PB full q_loc; PRMB q_step per step
arms.P_AGREE: PB: qA = mean of 4 leave-family-out q; v = share of views with the modal unique peak (tied views count as disagreement); c = 1 - H(qA)/log S; train iff v>=0.75 and c>=0.10, weight x v*c, renormalized. PRMB: qA_s = mean of 4 sigmoid views; step enters loss iff (qA_s<=0.25 or >=0.75) and >=3 of 4 views on qA_s's side of 0.5; target qA_s, step weight |2qA_s-1|
arms.P_RANDOM: PB circular roll of q_loc by a uniform shift in 1..S-1 (SeedSequence([20260923, answer_index])); PRMB permutation of q_step within the answer
arms.P_POSITION_LENGTH: same head/loss as P_SOFT on [r, r^2, log1p(S), log1p(tokens_in_step)], r = s/max(S-1,1); features scaled by B-only weighted mean/SD (floor 1e-8)
arms.P_SOFT_COVERAGE_MATCH: P_SOFT targets and base weights on the same number of answers (PB) / steps (PRMB) that P_AGREE kept, per cell x depth bin x relative-position bin, chosen by SHA256('coverage|uid|step_id|20260923') order (PB step_id = 'answer', position = teacher peak)

student.head: u_s = w^T Z_s + b
student.readout: PB earliest-tie argmax(u); PRMB u as ranking score; no temperature/scale tuning

sample_weights: PB: equal mass per dataset cell within task, then per source group in cell, then per answer in group. PRMB: equal per source group, then per answer. Step-level PRMB losses divide the answer mass by the selected-step weight sum.

splits.A: remaining two folds (unused in S1: teachers are fit-free)
splits.membership: source_group_id via FOLDS_V2 as joined in Step 432 OOF_ANSWERS.csv (verified in S0)

secondary: prmscore (C-calibrated inner-selected quantile and q80) on raw u AND on per-answer z(u) per the S0-C rule

bootstrap.pb: macro8 recomputed per draw with 8 denominators; invalid draw if any cell denominator is 0
bootstrap.prm: multiplicity-weighted mean of within-answer AUROC over eligible answers

diagnostics: teacher top1/true-step mass/entropy/rank on erroneous PB; confidence and abstention clean vs erroneous
PRMB hard-pseudo precision/recall, soft AUPRC, predicted positives vs true errors, by clean/single/multi
teacher/student 2x2 per arm; PRMB per-answer AUROC delta and corrected/destroyed pairs
interpretation: P_SOFT/P_AGREE differences isolate the target; a gain that P_POSITION_LENGTH also shows is a learned prior, not new error evidence; accuracy on the filtered P_AGREE subset does not substitute for full-H quality.
